Examination Regulations

Students must present a valid Northridge Campus Student ID card at least 15 minutes before the scheduled start of every written examination.

Permitted Materials

Only non-programmable scientific calculators approved by the course syllabus may be brought into the exam hall. Smartwatches and phones must remain powered off inside sealed bags.

Medical Makeup Examinations

Students who miss a final exam due to documented illness must submit a Makeup Exam Petition within 72 hours of the missed exam date through the Office of Examinations.
